businesses.business: industrial air quality and emissions control equipment

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures air pollution control, filtration, fluid handling and process equipment for industrial facilities. Sells to industrial, power, energy and manufacturing customers through engineered projects and aftermarket parts and services.

primary_products.value: industrial air pollution control systems; dust, mist and fume collectors and filters; catalytic and thermal oxidizers; industrial pumps and fluid handling equipment; heat transfer and process equipment

primary_services.value: aftermarket parts and replacement filters; maintenance and repair; equipment retrofits and upgrades; engineering and installation support

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial plants, power generators, refiners, petrochemical, metals, chemical and manufacturing companies, engineering contractors

end_markets.value: power generation; oil and gas; petrochemicals and refining; metals and mining; general industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: project or contract: engineered air quality and process systems built to customer specifications; product sales: filters, pumps, collectors and other standard equipment; service fees: aftermarket parts, maintenance, retrofits and repair work
revenue_model.category: project or contract; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: fabricates engineered equipment from steel and purchased components, sold to industrial end users and contractors

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia including China and India, and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: air pollution control, industrial filtration, and fluid handling and process equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales engineers selling to industrial end users and engineering firms; partners / resellers: independent sales representatives and agents in various regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: products help customers meet environmental rules such as EPA Clean Air Act and similar emissions regulations, demand regulation-driven

notes: Segment mix and recent acquisitions are from memory and may be slightly outdated.
